extracted.intended_audience: researchers, potential grantees, and the general public seeking information about the Simons Foundation and its funding priorities
extracted.subtask_description: The page summarizes the Simons Foundation's mission, program areas, institutional structure, and high-level priorities for grantmaking and in-house research (Flatiron Institute). It orients prospective applicants and stakeholders to what the foundation values and supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission — advance the frontiers of research in mathematics and the basic sciences
rubrics_metrics.description: The Simons Foundation’s mission is to advance the frontiers of research in mathematics and the basic sciences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the foundation's core organizing principle for its grantmaking and activities; funding and programs should align with advancing fundamental research in these fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program areas / funding focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The Simons Foundation makes grants in four areas: Mathematics & Physical Sciences, Life Sciences, Autism & Neuroscience, and Science, Society & Culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals and activities should fall within one of these program areas to be a primary fit for the foundation's grantmaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Champion basic science through grant funding and support for research and public engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Since its founding ... the foundation has been a champion of basic science through grant funding, support for research and public engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The foundation emphasizes funding that advances basic (fundamental) science and also supports efforts that connect research to public engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference for 'asking big questions' and providing sustained support
rubrics_metrics.description: We believe in asking big questions and providing sustained support to researchers working to unravel the mysteries of the universe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The foundation favors ambitious, long-term, fundamental research programs and grant strategies that provide ongoing/sustained support rather than short-term or narrowly incremental projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote collaboration across physical and intellectual barriers
rubrics_metrics.description: We actively promote collaboration across physical and intellectual barriers through a pioneering grantmaking approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interdisciplinary and cross-institutional collaboration is a valued characteristic; proposals that break down disciplinary/organizational barriers align with the foundation's approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to the sharing of knowledge within the scientific community
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to the sharing of knowledge within the scientific community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities that enhance openness, data/software/publication sharing, or otherwise disseminate findings to peers are aligned with the foundation's priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support diversity of perspectives in science
rubrics_metrics.description: Science requires a diversity of perspectives. We actively promote collaboration ... and are committed to the sharing of knowledge within the scientific community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The foundation values diversity (of perspectives, backgrounds, ideas) and supports initiatives that increase inclusivity and diverse participation in science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage science with society and culture; support public engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: We understand science is part of society and culture, and we actively provide opportunities for people to engage with science in ways that are relevant and meaningful to them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding and programs that integrate scientific research with societal relevance, outreach, education, or cultural engagement are within the foundation's remit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flatiron Institute — in-house computational research and team-based support
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Flatiron Institute was opened in 2016 and conducts scientific research in-house, supporting teams of top computational scientists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The foundation operates an internal research institute focused on computational science; relevant activities include team-based computational projects, software, and infrastructure development carried out within Flatiron.
